best_for: Home Windows users whose C: drive keeps filling up and who want to see, in one scan, which folders take the space.

points.title: See where the space went
points.text: TreeSize Free scans a drive and shows folder sizes down to single files, with a treemap chart and PDF reports. You find the big folders without clicking through each one.

points.title: Free for home use only
points.text: The free edition is meant for private, non-commercial use on desktops, and does not run on Windows Server. JAM Software points business users to the paid editions.

points.title: Paid editions add the cleanup tools
points.text: Duplicate file search, the largest-files filter and scan history start with TreeSize Personal at USD 25.20 per user per year. Professional, from USD 49 per user per year, adds scheduled scans and exports. Prices were read on the date below.

points.title: 64-bit and Windows 10 or later
points.text: TreeSize Free is 64-bit only since version 4.6, and 4.8 dropped Windows 8 and 8.1. Older versions stay available for older systems.

points.title: No admin rights needed
points.text: Since 4.8 you can install it into your user profile without administrator rights. The listing has both a per-user and a machine-wide installer.

points.title: Usage data is on by default
points.text: Version 4.8 added anonymous usage data collection. You can turn it off in the options.

points.title: Windows only
points.text: There is no Mac or Linux version. The listing keeps 3 versions.
